messages:
Taylor: FYI we need to close the Apr 22 postmortem loop for customer comms. Deliverables: 1) 1-2 line statuspage blurb, 2) 72h public summary, 3) enterprise outreach/email templates, 4) single-sentence RCA access policy and request flow. Also capture owners + firm deadlines.

Morgan: I can draft the statuspage blurb and push to staging. Prefer to keep it non-technical. ETA staging preview 2024-04-25 17:00 PT.

Riley: I’ll write the 72h public summary (public audience). Will include timeline, impact, mitigation, and a short note about recurrence pattern. ETA 2024-04-26 17:00 PT.

Dev: I'll own enterprise templates and CS scripts. Will include a private-briefing offer for materially impacted accounts. ETA 2024-04-26 COB.

Asha: Drafting the RCA access sentence for statuspage: propose: "A redacted public summary is available; impacted customers may request a detailed RCA via Support. Sensitive details may be shared under NDA at Legal's discretion." Sending to Legal now.

Taylor: Good. Also flagging this ties into the quarterly KV cache eviction pattern. Need an SRE follow-up with mitigations and monitoring updates. Who can take that?

Dev: I'll open a follow-up ticket and tag Platform SRE. ETA mitigation proposal 2024-05-08.

incident-bot: Ticket INC-6123 created and assigned to Dev. Link: https://tracker.redwood.example/INC-6123

Morgan: Statuspage draft: 
```
Status: Partial service disruption  Resolved
Summary: Between 03:12 and 03:42 UTC some requests to the embeddings endpoint experienced higher latency and errors for some requests. We mitigated the impact and service is operating normally. A public summary will be posted within 72 hours. To request a detailed RCA, contact Support (ref: INC-6123).
```

Asha: Tiny legal tweak: replace "errors" with "errors for some requests" and add the NDA clause. Updated and sent back.

Riley: 72h summary outline saved to doc: timeline, affected customers (buckets), mitigation steps, recurrence note, next steps, how to request RCA. Will loop Legal for redactions and CS for messaging.

Dev: SRE actions I'll open: 1) monitoring alert for pre-eviction memory trend -> owner Mateo, due 2024-05-06; 2) mitigation design -> owner Platform SRE, due 2024-05-08.

Taylor: OK. Action list to add to the incident tracker:
- Statuspage copy: Morgan -> staging 2024-04-25 17:00 PT, publish 2024-04-25 18:00 PT
- 72h public summary: Riley -> 2024-04-26 17:00 PT
- Enterprise outreach/templates: Dev -> 2024-04-26 COB
- RCA policy blurb & legal signoff: Asha -> signoff 2024-04-28
- Recurrence mitigation plan & monitoring: Mateo/Platform SRE -> proposal 2024-05-06, plan 2024-05-08

incident-bot: Follow-up reminder scheduled for 1755582000 (tomorrow 10:30 PT).
